fields.headline: Bowing out, pushing through, and the *third* option nobody taught us.
fields.text: What I did this week when the invites rolled in and my body said absolutely not. Swipe for the option I'd never tried.

fields.headline: The old *move*: disappear.
fields.text: Pain's up, anxiety's up, and everyone's making holiday plans. The old me would've said I'm not going to anything and let the pain take the blame. It's a clean exit, and it's lonely as hell.

fields.headline: The other move: *push* through.
fields.text: Say yes to everything, smile through it and pay for it for a week after. It looks like strength from the outside. From the inside it feels a lot like abandoning yourself.

fields.headline: Notice the *pull* first.
fields.text: This time I caught the urge to run before I acted on it. I felt where it lived in my body and didn't argue with it. That one pause changed everything after it.

fields.headline: Then say it *out loud*.
fields.text: Instead of hiding or performing, I told people the truth: I'm struggling right now. No speech, no list of reasons. Just the honest thing, said plainly.

fields.headline: Let the right people *meet* you.
fields.text: Not everyone will get it, and that's information too. The right people met me with understanding, and I'm still going. This time my needs come with me, out loud.

fields.headline: You don't have to pick between hiding and *pretending*.
Find the *third* option.
fields.text: Catch the urge to bail or push through, name what you actually need, and practice saying it before the plans get made. There's an app for that.
